AD2E.Character.Name: Name
AD2E.Roll.ModifierNoteHint: e.g. ring of protection, cover, blessed
AD2E.Test.NotAvailable: {test} is not available at this ability score.

AD2E.Class.OtherRequirements: This kit also has race, alignment or other restrictions; see the linked page.
AD2E.Class.MinStacks: Kit minimums add to the class's
AD2E.Class.MinStacksHint: The higher of the kit's and the class's minimum applies (Skills & Powers kits); unticked, the kit's minimum replaces the class's.
AD2E.Class.DropKit: Drag a Class Kit item here
AD2E.Class.DragHint: Drag a Race, a Class and then a Class Kit from the Items directory or the "Races (PHB)", "Classes (PHB)" and "Class Kits" compendiums onto this sheet. Dropping a new one replaces the current one.
AD2E.Class.NeedClassFirst: Add a Class before adding a Class Kit.
AD2E.Class.KitDoesNotFit: This kit is not available to the current class.

AD2E.Item.kitClassesHint: Comma-separated class identifiers, e.g. fighter, paladin
AD2E.Item.otherRequirements: Has race, alignment or other restrictions
AD2E.Item.kitMinHint: Overrides the class minimum for that ability. Blank keeps the class minimum; 0 removes it.

AD2E.Save.OverrideHint: Override (blank uses PHB Table 60 for the class group and level)
AD2E.Save.RollBonus: Bonus added to the roll: racial Constitution bonus (PHB Table 9, vs. rod/staff/wand and spell) and paladin +2 (all saves)

AD2E.HP.Fixed: +{hp} HP (fixed; no hit die or CON bonus at this level)
AD2E.HP.ConfirmReset: This character is above 1st level. Replace current and maximum HP with a new 1st-level roll?
AD2E.HP.XpRestart: hierophant druid: counted from 1 XP after stepping down as Grand Druid at 16th level

AD2E.Race.InfravisionByLineage: Infravision depends on lineage (see source page)
AD2E.Race.ConSaves: CON bonus vs. rod/staff/wand and spells (Table 9)
AD2E.Race.SaveBonus: Racial CON bonus (Table 9), added to the roll
AD2E.Race.PoisonBonus: Racial CON bonus vs. poison only (Table 9)
AD2E.Race.RolledScore: Rolled score (checked against the race's Table 7 limits)
AD2E.Race.EffectiveScore: Effective score: rolled + racial adjustment (Table 8); used for all tables and rolls
AD2E.Race.ClassNotAllowed: This race cannot take the current class.
AD2E.Race.LevelLimitReached: This race cannot advance beyond level {limit} in this class. Edit the level directly if your DM allows it.
AD2E.Race.KitRaceLimitsHint: race level, comma-separated, e.g. dwarf 15, gnome 6 (no number = unlimited)
AD2E.Race.KitRacesBarredHint: race identifiers, comma-separated, e.g. dwarf, elf
AD2E.Race.NeedsRaceKit: {race} can only be a {class} through a kit that allows {race}; add one.
AD2E.Race.NeedsKitNote: This race can only take this class through a kit that allows the race; add a qualifying kit.
AD2E.Race.KitNotForRace: {kit} is not available to {race} for this class.

AD2E.Prof.SpecFree: Free specialization: {weapons} (no extra slots, applies automatically)
AD2E.Prof.SpecMissing: The kit requires a weapon specialization: tick Specialized on one weapon proficiency.
AD2E.Prof.SkillsPowers: Skills & Powers (Table 45; rating used with the world setting)
AD2E.Prof.ExtraHint: Additional nonweapon slots spent on this proficiency: +1 to its checks for each (Nonweapon Proficiencies II (PHB)). They count against the slots available.
AD2E.Prof.CrossGroup: Outside this class's proficiency groups (Table 38): +1 slot
AD2E.Prof.CheckHint: Proficiency check: 1d20 ≤ this number (a 20 always fails)
AD2E.Prof.DragHint: Drag proficiencies from the "Proficiencies" compendium onto this sheet. Adding a Class Kit adds its bonus proficiencies (free) and required proficiencies (use slots); removing the kit removes its bonus proficiencies.
AD2E.Prof.ChooseOne: Choose one proficiency granted by this kit.

AD2E.Weapon.ElementHint: Elemental province of attacks with this weapon (Al-Qadim): its damage dice reach elemental mages and gens of that province, and an elemental mage of that province adds +1 per die.
AD2E.Weapon.BowStrengthHint: A bow made for a Strength gives the user's Strength attack and damage bonuses up to that Strength; penalties always apply. Bows for exceptional Strength (18/01 or more) cost three to five times the normal price (Weapons, PHB).
AD2E.Weapon.BowBendBars: bow made for Strength {rating}: roll bend bars/lift gates ({chance}%) to string or use it
AD2E.Weapon.AutoDamageSetting: Roll damage automatically on a hit
AD2E.Weapon.AutoDamageHint: When a weapon or monster attack hits, roll its damage at once with the attack's choices (ammunition, backstab, non-lethal, armed defender) and the first target's size (Large or bigger: the large damage). Unconditional kit modifiers apply; for situational ones or a modifier use the Damage button instead.
AD2E.Weapon.NoDamage: {name} has no damage listed on the PHB weapon list.
AD2E.Weapon.Specialize: Weapon specialization (fighters only): one extra slot, two for bows
AD2E.Weapon.SpecInvalid: Specialization requires a single-class fighter and a single specialized weapon
AD2E.Weapon.NoWeaponData: No weapon data; remove and re-add this proficiency from the compendium
AD2E.Weapon.PointBlankHint: Point blank range available (+2 to hit)
AD2E.Weapon.DropNotProficient: {name}: no matching weapon proficiency; attacks take the non-proficiency penalty ({penalty}).
AD2E.Weapon.DragHint: Weight of weapons, ammunition and armour counts toward encumbrance. Drag armour from the "Armour (PHB)" compendium and weapons and ammunition from the "Weapons (PHB)" compendium onto this sheet. A weapon uses the weapon proficiency with the same identifier; specialization is set on the proficiency. Firing a launcher uses one piece of the chosen ammunition; throwing a weapon uses one from its quantity.
AD2E.Weapon.EquipHint: No weapon in hand. Tick Equipped on the Equipment tab to ready a weapon.
AD2E.Weapon.StowHint: Sheathe, sling or stow the weapon: still carried, no longer in hand.
AD2E.Weapon.DropHint: Drop the weapon: no longer in hand or counted toward encumbrance until picked up (Equipment tab).

AD2E.Ammo.LaunchersHint: Fired from: comma-separated weapon identifiers (e.g. long-bow, short-bow).
AD2E.Ammo.None: {name}: no ammunition left. Add ammunition that fits it, or raise its quantity.

AD2E.Armor.SizeHint: Armour made for another size does not fit (no Armor Class). Small armour weighs half the listed weight, large 50% more; blank = made for its wearer, weighed by the wearer's size (Armor, PHB).
AD2E.Armor.Misfit: does not fit this character (no Armor Class)

Restrict.noArmor: not allowed for this class (wizards wear no armour)
Restrict.noShield: this class cannot use a shield
Restrict.tooHeavy: too heavy for this class (chain mail or lighter)

AD2E.Armor.RearHint: Attacks from behind: no shield, no beneficial Dexterity adjustment
AD2E.Armor.Unused: Another equipped item of this kind gives a better AC; this one is not counted
AD2E.Armor.MiscHint: Magical items (rings, cloaks or bracers of protection), spells, cover: positive improves (lowers) Armour Class. Applies to all AC values.

AD2E.Enc.MagicArmorHint: Magical armour counts toward the most weight that can be carried, not toward movement or combat (Encumbrance (PHB))
AD2E.Enc.OverMax: Over the most weight that can be carried: cannot move
AD2E.Enc.SettingHint: PHB optional rules: basic categories (Table 47), specific movement (Table 48), or off.

AD2E.Move.Hint: Movement rate: tens of feet per round in dungeons, tens of yards per round outdoors (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.SneakHint: Cautious (dungeon) pace: movement rate in tens of feet per round (Movement (PHB)). Thief Move Silently is a separate skill.
AD2E.Move.WalkHint: Walking pace: movement rate in tens of yards per round; at this pace in a dungeon, -1 to surprise rolls, +1 to others' chance of being surprised, and traps are not noticed (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.CombatHint: Combat round: movement x 10 ft. Close to melee and attack: {close} ft; withdraw: {withdraw} ft; charge: {charge} ft (+2 to hit, AC +1, no Dexterity bonus) (Movement in Combat (PHB))
AD2E.Move.JogHint: Double movement in yards; {rounds} rounds (Constitution), then a Constitution check each round (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.RunHint: x3 with a Strength check, x4 with a Strength check at -4; Constitution check each round at -1 (x3) / -2 (x4) per round run, cumulative (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.SprintHint: x5 with a Strength check at -8; Constitution check each round at -3 per round, cumulative (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.JumpHint: Jumping proficiency (PHB): running broad / running high · standing broad / standing high (ft); 20 ft running start; click to roll
AD2E.Move.NoJump: The PHB gives jump distances only for the Jumping proficiency
AD2E.Move.BroadCap: no more than six times the character's height
AD2E.Move.HighCap: no more than 1 1/2 times the character's height
AD2E.Move.MarchHint: Miles per 10-hour day: march (x2) / force march (x2 1/2, Constitution check each day) (Movement (PHB))
AD2E.Move.MountedHint: Riding {name} (load {weight} / {full} lb, rider included): its movement per round in tens of yards outdoors; miles per day equal to its movement rate, pushed to double at the risk of lameness and exhaustion (Movement (DMG), Mounted Overland Movement).

AD2E.Coin.Hint: Exchange (PHB Table 42): 1 pp = 5 gp, 1 gp = 2 ep = 10 sp = 100 cp. Coins of any metal weigh 50 to the pound (DMG) and count toward encumbrance.
AD2E.Coin.NoneYet: No coins yet. Drag coins from the "Equipment (PHB)" compendium; a dropped stack joins an owned stack of the same coin.

AD2E.Gear.AcquisitionHint: POSM Table 16: FS field search, TM town or market, SO special order, Auto found by anyone who looks.
AD2E.Gear.CarriedHint: Carried items count toward encumbrance (weight x quantity)
AD2E.Gear.LoadFull: Animal load at full move (lb, PHB Table 49)
AD2E.Gear.NoneYet: No gear yet. Drag items from the "Equipment (PHB)" compendium.

AD2E.Monster.HitDiceHint: As written in the Monstrous Manual: 3, 3+3, 1-1, 1/2, 2-8 hp. Hit Dice are d8.
AD2E.Monster.MoraleHint: Morale check: 2d10, the creature stands on a total at or below its morale (Morale (DMG))
AD2E.Monster.SaveLevelHint: Save level = Hit Dice (+1 per 4 added points or fraction); non-intelligent creatures use half except vs. paralyzation, poison and death magic (The Saving Throw (DMG))
AD2E.Monster.ElementHint: Elemental province of the attack (e.g. a fire breath: flame). Its damage dice reach elemental mages and gens of that province (-2 per die).
AD2E.Monster.ElementGuess: Suggested element: {province} ("{word}" in the {from}); not applied.
AD2E.Monster.InventoryHint: Drag weapons, armour, equipment and coins here. Equipped armour sets AC; weapons add attacks; carried weight counts toward a mount's load.

Load.label: Load (mounts: PHB Table 49)
Load.other: Other load (cargo, or a rider not linked to a character; lb)

AD2E.Monster.NoAttacks: No attacks: add one, or drag a weapon onto the sheet.

AD2E.Manual.Title: AD&D 2e GM manual
AD2E.Manual.MenuHint: How the system works: GM tools (monster and spell import and update, experience, treasure, reactions), every system setting with its current value and what it does, and how characters, combat, monsters, items and the optional rules are used.
AD2E.Manual.GmOnly: These tools are for the GM.

AD2E.Importer.Title: Monster importer (Complete Compendium)
AD2E.Importer.MenuHint: Import monster stat blocks from completecompendium.com into this world as Monster / NPC actors, by setting and source book.
AD2E.Importer.Hint: Imports stat blocks (game statistics), a link to each monster's page and its picture as portrait and token (a copy in this world's ad2e-monsters folder, or the site's address if the world setting is off); the descriptions stay on the site. Source:
AD2E.Importer.LocalSetting: Store imported monster pictures in the world
AD2E.Importer.LocalSettingHint: The monster importer downloads each picture once into worlds/<this world>/ad2e-monsters and uses that copy for the portrait and token, so players' browsers do not load it from completecompendium.com. The pictures are not shipped with the system. Off: actors link to the site's address.
AD2E.Importer.LocalFailed: Monster pictures could not be stored in this world (no upload permission or another file storage); the actors use the site's address instead.
AD2E.Importer.Folder: Put new actors in a folder named after the book
AD2E.Importer.SomeFailed: {n} monster page(s) could not be loaded: {keys}
AD2E.Importer.UpdateHint: Re-read the page of every imported monster in this world and in unlocked world compendiums and update its stat block (names, current hit points, pictures a GM chose and attack elements a GM set stay). Pictures are stored as WebP (Foundry does not load the site's GIFs as token images); token footprints follow the size letter (T 0.5, S/M 1, L 2, H 3, G 4 squares; only over the default 1x1); tokens already placed on scenes get the new picture and size. Also game.ad2e.updateMonsters().
AD2E.Importer.Updated: Monsters updated: {updated}; page or stat block not found: {failed}; placed tokens given the new picture or size: {tokens}.
AD2E.Importer.GmOnly: Only a GM can update monsters.

AD2E.Spell.ProvincesHint: Al-Qadim provinces of the spell: flame, sand, sea, wind (Wizard Spells by Province (AA); set at import). Comma separated.
AD2E.Spell.DamageFormulaHint: Read from the spell's page at import (check them): roll formulas, @level = casting level, e.g. (min(@level, 10))d6. A button on the Spells tab rolls them.
AD2E.Spell.DamageHint: Roll this spell's damage or healing (elemental mage +1 per die in its province)
AD2E.Spell.BadDamage: {name}: the damage formula "{formula}" could not be rolled.
AD2E.Spell.MaterialsHint: Linked to items in the Spell Components compendium (matched automatically at import: check them against the spell's page). Consumed components are used up when the spell is cast (Casting Spells (PHB)); holy symbols are not.
AD2E.Spell.ConsumedHint: Used up when the spell is cast. "Whatever the component, it is automatically destroyed or lost when the spell is cast, unless the spell description specifically notes otherwise" (Casting Spells (PHB)).
AD2E.Spell.NoCaster: This class casts no spells (or no class item yet).
AD2E.Spell.RestHint: After rest: every memorized spell can be cast again
AD2E.Spell.DragHint: Drag spells from the "Spells (examples)" compendium or from imported spells (Configure Settings > Import spells). Set how many times each is memorized with -/+; Cast uses one.
AD2E.Spell.KnownHint: Wizards: most spells per level in the spell book (Intelligence, PHB Table 4)
AD2E.Spell.NotForClass: not a spell of this class
AD2E.Spell.Remaining: {n} left to cast until the next rest.
AD2E.Spell.WrongKind: {name} is not a spell the {class} class can cast; it is added but not counted.
AD2E.Spell.OppositionSchool: {name} belongs to an opposition school of the {class}.
AD2E.Spell.SphereNotAllowed: {name} is outside the spheres the {class} can cast.

AD2E.SpellImporter.Title: Spell importer (AD&D 2e wiki)
AD2E.SpellImporter.MenuHint: Import spells from the AD&D 2e wiki into this world as spell items, by source book, class and level.
AD2E.SpellImporter.Hint: Imports game statistics (school, sphere, level, range, components, casting time, duration, area, save), a link to each spell's page and links to its material components (Spell Components compendium; matched automatically, check them on the spell sheet) into the world compendium "Imported Spells"; the descriptions stay on the wiki. Source:
AD2E.SpellImporter.Folder: File spells into folders by class and spell level (e.g. Wizard Spells / Level 3)
AD2E.SpellImporter.Skipped: {n} page(s) without a usable spell infobox were skipped.
AD2E.SpellImporter.UpdateHint: Re-read the wiki page of every spell in the world (Items directory, characters' spells, Imported Spells compendium) and refresh its statistics and material component links. Memorization, learned status, notes and names stay.
AD2E.SpellImporter.Updated: Spells updated: {updated}; without a wiki page: {skipped}; page not found or not a spell: {failed}.
AD2E.SpellImporter.GmOnly: Only a GM can update spells.
AD2E.SpellImporter.Locked: The compendium {pack} is locked: unlock it to import spells.

AD2E.Skill.BudgetHint: Thief: 60 at 1st level, +30 per level, no more than 30 on one skill at 1st level and 15 per level after. Bard: 20 at 1st level, +15 per level (PHB).
AD2E.Skill.Cap: No thief skill above 95% including all adjustments (Thief (PHB))
AD2E.Skill.BelowOne: Below 1% after adjustments: spend points to raise it to at least 1% before it can be used (Thief, PHB)
AD2E.Skill.RangerNote: Studded leather or lighter armour only; halved outside natural surroundings (Ranger (PHB)).
AD2E.Skill.TrapNote: Removing a trap: a roll of 96-100 sets it off (Thief Skill Explanations (PHB)).
AD2E.Skill.KitAdjustHint: Percentage added to (or taken from) the character's thief, bard or ranger skills while the kit fits the class. Kit pages give these in their text; enter them here.
AD2E.Skill.PerSkillMax: At most {n} points on one skill at this level

AD2E.Ability2.BackstabText: +4 to hit from behind an unaware, roughly humanoid victim; damage ×{mult} (Table 30), first attack only.
AD2E.Ability2.TurnHint: Roll 1d20: equal to or above the number turns; T = turned, D = destroyed, D* = 2d4 more destroyed; a success affects 2d6 undead (Turning Undead (PHB)).
AD2E.Ability2.LayOnHandsText: Heals {hp} hit points (2 per level), once per day.
AD2E.Ability2.LayOnHandsUsed: Lay on hands has been used today; rest to restore it.
AD2E.Ability2.LayOnHandsChat: Lay on hands: {hp} hit points restored.
AD2E.Ability2.KitText: Special benefits and hindrances are described on the kit page:
AD2E.Ability2.Rested: {name} rested: memorized spells and daily abilities restored.
AD2E.Ability2.None: This class has no special abilities listed here (or no class item yet).

specialization.name: Weapon specialization
specialization.text: Extra weapon slots buy specialization: see the Proficiencies tab.

followers.name: Followers
followers.text: At 9th level attracts men-at-arms and an elite bodyguard (Table 16).

detectEvil.name: Detect evil
detectEvil.text: Senses evil intent up to 60 feet in one direction; takes a round; at will.

saves.name: +2 to all saving throws
saves.text: Added to every saving throw roll (included in the Saves table).

disease.name: Immune to disease
disease.text: Curses such as lycanthropy and mummy rot are not diseases.

layOnHands.name: Lay on hands
layOnHands.text: Heals 2 hit points per level, once per day.

cureDisease.name: Cure disease
cureDisease.text: Once per week for every five levels (levels 1-5: once, 6-10: twice, ...).

aura.name: Aura of protection
aura.text: 10-foot radius: summoned and evil creatures have -1 to attack rolls.

turnUndead.name: Turn undead
turnUndead.text: From 3rd level, as a cleric two levels lower.

spells.name: Priest spells
spells.text: From 9th level: combat, divination, healing and protection spheres (Table 17); no Wisdom bonus.

noFollowers.name: No followers
noFollowers.text: Attracts no followers; may hire lawful good soldiers and specialists.

twoWeapons.name: Two weapons
twoWeapons.text: No penalty fighting with two weapons in studded leather or lighter armour (no shield).

tracking.name: Tracking
tracking.text: Tracking proficiency for free; +1 per three levels (3rd-5th +1, 6th-8th +2, ...).

stealth.name: Hide in shadows / move silently
stealth.text: Table 18 by level, race and Dexterity adjusted; studded leather or lighter; halved outside natural surroundings.

speciesEnemy.name: Species enemy
speciesEnemy.text: Chosen before 2nd level: +4 to attack rolls against it.

animals.name: Animal empathy
animals.text: Befriends domestic animals; wild or attack-trained animals save vs. rods at -1 per three ranger levels.

spells.name: Priest spells
spells.text: From 8th level: plant and animal spheres (Table 18); no Wisdom bonus.

turnUndead.name: Turn undead
turnUndead.text: Table 61 at the cleric's level (evil clerics command instead).

followers.name: Followers
followers.text: At 8th level, with a place of worship of significant size, attracts believers.

stronghold.name: Stronghold
stronghold.text: At 9th level may receive approval to establish a religious stronghold.

language.name: Druidic language
language.text: Secret language of druids (no proficiency slot).

passPlants.name: Pass through overgrowth
passPlants.text: From 3rd level, at normal movement and leaving no trail.

woodlandLanguages.name: Woodland languages
woodlandLanguages.text: One language of woodland creatures at 3rd level and one more each level after.

charmImmunity.name: Immune to woodland charm
charmImmunity.text: From 7th level, immune to charm spells of woodland creatures.

shapechange.name: Shapechange
shapechange.text: From 7th level, up to three times a day (reptile, bird, mammal; each once a day).

skills.name: Thief skills
skills.text: Tables 26-29 plus discretionary points: see the skills table.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.text: +4 to hit, damage multiplied by Table 30; first attack only.

scrolls.name: Use scrolls
scrolls.text: From 10th level; 25% chance to read the scroll wrongly (reversed effect).

abilities.name: Bard abilities
abilities.text: Climb walls, detect noise, pick pockets, read languages (Table 33) plus points: see the table.

influence.name: Influence reactions
influence.text: A performance can shift the mood of a group that is not attacking.

counterSong.name: Counter song
counterSong.text: Allies within 30 feet are immune to song or poetry attacks while the bard counters (save vs. spell).

spells.name: Wizard spells
spells.text: From 2nd level (Table 32); kept in a spell book.

scrolls.name: Use magical writings
scrolls.text: From 10th level; 15% chance of reading an item wrongly.

spellBook.name: Spell book
spellBook.text: Spells are memorized from the spell book; a spell cast is gone until memorized again.

learnSpells.name: Learning spells
learnSpells.text: A new spell is learned on a percentile roll at or under the Intelligence chance to learn (Table 4), up to the maximum spells per level.

noArmor.name: No armour
noArmor.text: Wizards wear no armour; weapons: dagger, staff, darts, knives and slings.

magicItems.name: Magical items
magicItems.text: Can use more magical items than any other class: potions, rings, wands, rods, scrolls and most miscellaneous items.

scrollsPotions.name: Scrolls and potions
scrollsPotions.text: From 9th level, can write magical scrolls and brew potions; other items need the right spells.

noStronghold.name: Henchmen and apprentices
noStronghold.text: No special benefit from a stronghold; may acquire a few henchmen and apprentices.

extraSpell.name: Extra school spell
extraSpell.text: One additional spell per spell level, of the specialist's school (included in the Spells tab).

schoolSaves.name: School saving throws
schoolSaves.text: +1 to saves against spells of the school cast by other wizards; others save at -1 against the specialist's school spells.

learnBonus.name: Learning spells
learnBonus.text: +15% to learn spells of the school, -15% for other schools.

opposition.name: Opposition schools
opposition.text: Cannot learn spells of the opposition schools or use items that duplicate them (see the Race & Class tab).

newSpellLevel.name: Free school spell
newSpellLevel.text: Gains one spell of the school for the spell book on reaching each new spell level.

Armor.light: in no armour, leather or padded
Armor.studded: in no armour, leather, padded or studded leather

AD2E.Kit.ModifiersHint: Taken from the kit page (curated; the kit link has the full rules). Applied modifiers are already in the sheet's numbers; situational ones can be ticked in the roll dialog; reaction and surprise modifiers are for the DM's rolls. Armour Class bonuses mean a better (lower) AC; an initiative bonus lowers the initiative roll.
AD2E.Kit.SheetHint: Generated from the kit page by tools/build-kit-mechanics.py; modifiers without a condition apply automatically while the kit fits the character's class.
AD2E.Kit.NoModifiers: No numeric modifiers are stated on the kit page.
AD2E.Kit.SkillPoints: Thief skill points: {first} at 1st level, {per} per level after
AD2E.Kit.BardPoints: Bard ability points: {first} at 1st level, the usual points per level after

AD2E.Magic.SheetHint: Magical armour and weapons are armour and weapon items with a magical bonus. Charges: each use spends one (wands are found with 1d20+80). Potions, scrolls and dusts are used up from the quantity. Effects on rolls: add them in the roll dialog's modifier; on Armour Class: the character's Other AC adjustment.
AD2E.Magic.UseHint: Spend a charge (or one potion, scroll or dust) and post the item to chat
AD2E.Magic.NoneYet: No magical items. Drag magical items here.

AD2E.Treasure.SheetHint: Gems with no value entered are worth their DMG Table 85 class base value (uncut: 10%). Jewellery and objects of art: DMG Table 87 gives value ranges; enter the value.
AD2E.Treasure.Treasure: Gems, jewellery and objects of art
AD2E.Treasure.NoneYet: No gems or jewellery. Drag them here.

AD2E.Init.SettingHint: When one combatant rolls initiative from the combat tracker, ask for its action (weapon speed factor, spell casting time, magical item, breath weapon, innate ability, natural weapons by size), the standard situations (Initiative (PHB) Table 55) and a modifier. Rolling several at once never asks and uses each combatant's weapon in hand (or natural weapons).
AD2E.Init.Title: Initiative: {name}
AD2E.Init.Hint: 1d10, lowest acts first. Action modifiers: Initiative (PHB) Table 56; magical weapons are faster by their bonus.
AD2E.Init.EndOfRound: takes effect at the end of the round
AD2E.Init.ModeHint: Individual (optional rule): each combatant rolls 1d10. Group (optional rule): one 1d10 per side each round, each combatant adds its own action modifiers (Table 56). Standard: one 1d10 per side each round, the whole side acts on it. Sides are token dispositions (friendly, neutral, hostile); the GM makes the side rolls (Initiative, PHB).

Mode.group: Group (one roll per side + each combatant's modifiers)

ModeNote.group: Group initiative: the side's roll replaces the 1d10.
ModeNote.standard: Standard initiative: the whole side acts on its roll; only situations and a modifier apply.

AD2E.Init.SideGmFirst: The GM rolls initiative for this side first (group or standard initiative).
AD2E.Init.ScrollTime: Casting time of the spell on the scroll

AD2E.AbilityRoll.Title: Roll ability scores
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Method2: Method II: 3d6 twice per ability, keep one
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Method4: Method IV: 3d6 twelve times, choose six, assign
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Method5: Method V: 4d6 drop lowest, six times, assign
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Method6: Method VI: each ability 8, add seven d6
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Hint2: Two 3d6 rolls per ability, in order (Strength first); pick one of each pair (Rolling Ability Scores (PHB)).
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Hint3: Six 3d6 rolls; assign each to one ability.
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Hint4: Twelve 3d6 rolls; assign six of them, one per ability (the six highest are preselected).
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Hint5: Six rolls of 4d6, the lowest die discarded; assign each to one ability.
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Hint6: Every ability starts at 8. Add each of the seven dice, whole, to one ability; no score above 18 (an 18 only by exact count).
AD2E.AbilityRoll.UsedTwice: Roll #{roll} is assigned to more than one ability.
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Unassigned: Assign a roll to every ability.
AD2E.AbilityRoll.OverMax: {ability} would be {score}; no score may exceed {max}.
AD2E.AbilityRoll.Exceptional: Roll exceptional Strength (d100): warrior with Strength 18
AD2E.AbilityRoll.ConfirmApply: Replace this character's rolled ability scores with these?
AD2E.AbilityRoll.DiceLeft: Add every die to an ability.

AD2E.TabColours.SettingHint: Colours the Combat, Scenes, Actors, Items, Journal and Compendium tab icons with a colour-blind-friendly palette (Okabe-Ito) and underlines the open one. Other tabs are unchanged.

AD2E.Opaque.SettingHint: Give AD&D 2e sheets and windows a solid background. Foundry's windows are slightly transparent and rely on a blur that is turned off in low-performance mode, which lets text behind a window show through.

AD2E.Health.SettingHint: When characters die. Standard: at 0 hit points (Character Death, PHB). Hovering on Death's Door (DMG optional rule): unconscious at 0, losing 1 hit point each round until wounds are bound, dead at -10. Monsters always die at 0.
AD2E.Health.RuleDeathsDoor: Hovering on Death's Door: unconscious at 0, dead at -10 (DMG optional)
AD2E.Health.RuleStandardShort: Death rule: dead at 0 hit points
AD2E.Health.RuleDeathsDoorShort: Death rule: Hovering on Death's Door (dead at -10)

State.feeble: Weak and feeble until a day of rest

AD2E.Health.MassiveHint: 50 or more points from a single attack: saving throw vs. death or die (Character Death, PHB).
AD2E.Health.NowFeeble: Restored to 1 hit point only: weak and feeble until a day of rest; memorized spells are lost.
AD2E.Health.MassiveSaved: Massive damage: saving throw vs. death {roll} (needs {target}) — survives the shock.
AD2E.Health.MassiveFailed: Massive damage: saving throw vs. death {roll} (needs {target}) — dies of the shock.
AD2E.Health.NoHealingDead: Healing has no effect on {name}, who is dead (raise dead or resurrection is needed).
AD2E.Health.FeebleNoCure: Further cures do {name} no good until a day of rest.
AD2E.Health.Bound: {name}'s wounds are bound: no further loss of hit points, still unconscious.
AD2E.Health.RestHint: Natural healing (PHB): 1 hit point per day of rest; complete bed rest 3 per day, plus the Constitution bonus for each full week. Needs food, water and sleep.
AD2E.Health.RaiseHint: Raise dead or resurrection: resurrection survival roll (Table 3); success lowers Constitution by 1 permanently.
AD2E.Health.CannotRaise: {name}'s Constitution is too low to be raised.
AD2E.Health.ApplyHealing: Apply as healing to selected tokens
AD2E.Health.PunchNote: ({n} punching damage: 75% of it returns after the fight)
AD2E.Health.TempNote: ({n} of it temporary, returning one turn after the fight)
AD2E.Health.TempRecovered: {name} recovers {n} hit points of temporary damage ({before} → {after}).
AD2E.Health.PunchLasting: {n} of the punching damage is lasting.
AD2E.Health.RecoverHint: Attacking Without Killing (PHB): 75% of punching damage returns at the end of the fight and the temporary half of non-lethal weapon damage one turn after it. Done automatically when a combat encounter ends (non-lethal: after one turn of game time); this button does it now.
AD2E.Health.ApplyDamageRollTargets: Apply damage to the targets of the roll
AD2E.Health.ApplyDamageMyTargets: Apply damage to my targeted tokens
AD2E.Health.ApplyHealingRollTargets: Apply as healing to the targets of the roll
AD2E.Health.ApplyHealingMyTargets: Apply as healing to my targeted tokens
AD2E.Health.NotOwner: No permission to change {name}'s hit points; ask the GM to apply it.

NoTargets.roll: The roll had no targeted tokens.
NoTargets.mine: Target one or more tokens first (T key or right-click > Target).
NoTargets.selected: Select one or more tokens first.

AD2E.Surprise.Title: Surprise
AD2E.Surprise.Hint: 1d10: surprised on 1-3 (The Surprise Roll, PHB); a plus makes surprise less likely. Situations: DMG Table 57.

AD2E.Xp.Title: Award experience
AD2E.Xp.MenuHint: Divide a group experience award equally among the party (Experience Point Awards, DMG), with each character's prime requisite bonus. Also game.ad2e.awardExperience().
AD2E.Xp.Hint: Group awards are divided equally among the party (Experience Point Awards, DMG). Pick defeated monsters from the current combat and add other XP (story, treasure); each share gets the character's prime requisite bonus.

AD2E.TwoWeapons.Label: Two weapons
AD2E.TwoWeapons.both: Both weapons (this one main, the other second)
AD2E.TwoWeapons.NoBackstab: backstab applies to the main weapon only
AD2E.TwoWeapons.NeedsTwoHands: {name} needs two hands (size {weapon} weapon, size {size} wielder) and cannot be used with a second weapon
AD2E.TwoWeapons.RateHint: Attacks per round: {rate}; {two} with a second weapon in hand (one extra attack per round)
AD2E.TwoWeapons.Shield: a shield cannot be used while fighting with two weapons
AD2E.TwoWeapons.TooLarge: the second weapon must be smaller and lighter than {main} (a dagger is always allowed)
AD2E.TwoWeapons.Summary: Two weapons: main {main}, second {off} (one extra attack per round, shown in brackets after the attack rate)

AD2E.Learn.DropText: Roll to learn this spell ({chance}% chance, Intelligence PHB Table 4), or add it as already known?
AD2E.Learn.Success: understood: copied into the spell book
AD2E.Learn.Failure: not understood: no new try until the next level
AD2E.Learn.MaxSettingHint: Enforce Intelligence (PHB) Table 4 "Max # of Spells per Level" when a wizard learns a spell.

Blocked.notWizard: {name}: only wizard spells are learned this way
Blocked.opposition: {name}: a specialist cannot learn spells of an opposition school
Blocked.level: {name}: above the highest spell level this Intelligence allows
Blocked.full: {name}: the maximum number of spells of this level is already known
Blocked.failed: {name}: failed at level {level}; another try after the next level
Blocked.province: {name}: an elemental province this kit cannot learn
Blocked.noProvince: {name}: choose the kit's elemental province(s) on the Class tab first
Blocked.kitLevel: {name}: above the highest spell level this kit can learn

AD2E.Henchmen.Title: Henchmen
AD2E.Henchmen.LifetimeHint: Charisma sets the most henchmen a character can ever have: "This is a lifetime limit, not just a maximum possible at any given time" (Henchmen, PHB). Current henchmen plus those lost.
AD2E.Henchmen.LostHint: Former henchmen (dead, departed): they still count toward the lifetime limit.
AD2E.Henchmen.LoyaltyHint: Charisma (PHB Table 6): added to the henchmen's loyalty (morale) score.
AD2E.Henchmen.TooHigh: Equal or higher level: "Should he ever equal or surpass the PC's level, the henchman leaves forever" (Henchmen, PHB)
AD2E.Henchmen.Remove: Remove from henchmen (add to Lost if the henchman is gone for good)
AD2E.Henchmen.DropHint: Drag an actor here to make it a henchman.
AD2E.Henchmen.MoraleHint: 2d10: the creature holds if the roll is at or under its morale rating with these modifiers (Morale, DMG).

AD2E.Reaction.Title: Encounter reaction
AD2E.Reaction.Hint: 2d10 on DMG Table 59, lower is friendlier. Add modifiers from the creature's description or the morale modifiers. The speaking character's Charisma reaction adjustment and kit reaction modifiers are subtracted (a bonus makes the reaction friendlier). The result is shown to the GM only.
AD2E.Reaction.Speaker: Speaking character

AD2E.Unarmed.CreatureHint: Unintelligent creatures do not punch, wrestle or overbear; a creature's natural weapons stay usable at close quarters (Nonlethal Combat and Creatures, PHB).
AD2E.Unarmed.ArmedTarget: {names} armed: strikes first, before this attack, with +{bonus} to attack and damage
AD2E.Unarmed.VsUnarmed: Against an unarmed attacker closing in (+{bonus} attack and damage)
AD2E.Unarmed.Title: Unarmed
AD2E.Unarmed.Meta: Punching, wrestling, overbearing (Attacking Without Killing, PHB)

Hint.punch: Damage and knockout chance by the modified roll (PHB Table 58).
Hint.wrestle: Needs both hands free. Move by the modified roll (PHB Table 58); armour gives the Table 57 penalty.
Hint.overbear: Several attackers: one roll at the weakest attacker's THAC0, +1 per extra attacker; size of the largest.

AD2E.Unarmed.ArmedDefender: An armed defender strikes first with +{bonus} to attack and damage.
AD2E.Unarmed.HoldRound: Maintain a hold: round (2+, no roll)
AD2E.Unarmed.Down: Defender already pulled down (attempt to pin)
AD2E.Unarmed.PulledDown: Hit: the defender is pulled down
AD2E.Unarmed.PunchDamage: {damage} punching damage ({lasting}% lasting, the rest temporary; split the total after the fight)

AD2E.AQ.HeatSetting: Al-Qadim: heat penalty for heavy armour
AD2E.AQ.HeatSettingHint: Armor in Fiery Zakhara (Arabian Adventures): armour better than AC 7 gives -1 per class to attack rolls and to proficiency and ability checks (only the armour's own rating; magical bonuses, daraqs and bucklers do not count).

AD2E.Container.Hint: Drag an item row onto a container to put it in, or choose the container on the item's sheet. Contents count toward the load while the container is carried (PHB Table 50 gives each container's capacity).
AD2E.Container.NoneYet: No containers. Backpacks, sacks, pouches, baskets, chests and saddle bags (PHB Table 50) hold gear.
AD2E.Container.NotCarried: not carried: contents do not count
AD2E.Container.WeightlessHint: The container's contents do not add to the weight carried (Bag of Holding, Portable Hole).
AD2E.Container.CarriedHint: In a container: carried while the container is carried.
AD2E.Container.CannotHold: {name} cannot go into that container (it would be inside itself).
AD2E.Container.Clash: A bag of holding and a portable hole inside one another: see Portable Hole (Magic Container).

AD2E.Animal.Title: Mounts & pack animals
AD2E.Animal.DropHint: Drag a mount, pack animal or pet actor onto this sheet (Hirelings & Mounts compendium). A ridden animal's load includes the rider and everything the rider carries (Encumbrance (PHB)).
AD2E.Animal.BodyWeightHint: The character's own weight (PHB Table 10). It counts toward the load of an animal the character rides.
AD2E.Animal.RollHint: PHB Table 10: base weight for the race and sex plus the modifier dice.
AD2E.Animal.NoRaceWeight: No PHB Table 10 weight for this race: enter the body weight by hand.
AD2E.Animal.RiderNoBody: body weight not set + gear {gear} lb
AD2E.Animal.RiderHint: What a ridden animal carries for this character: body weight plus the encumbrance load (clothing included).
AD2E.Animal.RidingHint: Ride this animal: its load includes this character's weight as a rider. One animal at a time.
AD2E.Animal.InCompendium: Compendium entry: it cannot carry a load or a rider until it is imported into the world (Import).
AD2E.Animal.ImportHint: Import a copy of this animal into the world (Actors sidebar) and use it here; the Riding box then appears.
AD2E.Animal.ImportFirst: {name} is in a compendium: import it into the world (Actors sidebar) first, then drag it onto the character.
AD2E.Animal.Imported: {name} imported from the compendium into the world and added to the character.
AD2E.Animal.Error: The mounts and pack animals could not be shown (see the browser console).
AD2E.Animal.RiderOnMount: Rider: {name} (body {body} + gear {gear} lb; own load {own} lb)
AD2E.Animal.RiderOnMountNoBody: Rider: {name} (body weight not set; gear {gear} lb; own load {own} lb)

AD2E.Familiar.Title: Familiar
AD2E.Familiar.Rule: Find Familiar (Wizard Spell): one familiar at a time; empathic link up to {range}; +1 to surprise while it lives and is within reach; apart, it loses 1 hit point a day; if it dies, the wizard rolls system shock and loses 1 Constitution.
AD2E.Familiar.None: No familiar. The GM can roll Find Familiar here, or drag a familiar actor onto the sheet.
AD2E.Familiar.Missing: The linked familiar actor was not found (deleted?).
AD2E.Familiar.NearHint: The familiar is within the 1 mile link: the +1 surprise bonus applies.
AD2E.Familiar.SeparatedHint: Separated from the wizard: the familiar loses 1 hit point each day of world time (applied by the GM's client).
AD2E.Familiar.FindHint: GM: roll the Find Familiar spell (2d12 hours, d20 table); a familiar that comes is created and linked.
AD2E.Familiar.FindText: {name} casts Find Familiar: {time} hours of casting and {cost} of incense and herbs in a brass brazier. The roll is whispered to the GMs.
AD2E.Familiar.TooSoon: The last attempt was {days} days ago: the spell can be attempted but once per year.
AD2E.Familiar.LastAttempt: Last Find Familiar attempt: {days} days ago (world time).
AD2E.Familiar.GmOnly: Find Familiar is rolled by the GM (the DM secretly determines all results).
AD2E.Familiar.HasOne: {name} is already this wizard's familiar (one at a time).
AD2E.Familiar.NoneCame: no familiar available within spell range
AD2E.Familiar.Dies: fails the system shock check and dies;
AD2E.Familiar.Pines: {name} is apart from its master: -{days} hit point(s), now {hp}.
AD2E.Familiar.PinedAway: {name} is apart from its master and dies (0 hit points).
AD2E.Familiar.MasterSave: In physical contact with {name}: {name}'s saving throw against a special attack ({n}+)
AD2E.Familiar.SpecialNone: no damage from the special attack
AD2E.Familiar.SpecialHalf: half damage from the special attack
AD2E.Familiar.ContactText: {name} is in physical contact with {master}. Against a special attack it uses {master}'s saving throw: no damage if it saved, half if it failed.

AD2E.Components.SettingHint: Casting a spell with linked material components checks the caster's items (Spell Components compendium) and removes one of each consumed component; missing components ask to cast anyway. Optional: Material Spell Components (POSM).
AD2E.Components.MissingText: {actor} does not carry: {list}. Cast the spell anyway?

AD2E.Elemental.SorcererHint: Sorcerer (Character Kit): two of the four provinces. +20% to learn their spells; spells of the other two cannot be learned.
AD2E.Elemental.ProvinceHint: Elemental Mage (Character Kit): one of the four provinces. +1 to each damage die of an attack using it; -2 to each damage die of an attack using it against the mage (at least 0).
AD2E.Elemental.Warded: {name} (elemental mage): {from} damage becomes {to} (-2 per die of its own province).

AD2E.SPProf.SettingHint: Player's Option: Skills & Powers chapter 6: a nonweapon proficiency on Table 45 is checked against its initial rating plus the Table 44 modifier of the better of its abilities (subabilities count as their ability), instead of the PHB ability score and modifier. Character points are not used: each extra slot spent on the proficiency adds +1, up to an unmodified rating of 16. Proficiencies not on Table 45 keep the PHB check. Reloads the world.
AD2E.SPProf.HintCapped: Skills & Powers: rating {base} + {extra} extra slots, at most {unmodified} (Improving Proficiencies), {ability} {mod} (Table 44)

AD2E.SP.SettingHint: Player's Option: Skills & Powers chapter 7: weapon group, fighting style, armour and shield proficiencies, weapon of choice, expertise, specialization for every class (Table 53) and mastery (Table 54), Table 50 non-proficiency and familiarity penalties. Character point costs are paid with weapon proficiency slots (CP / 2 for warriors, / 3 for others, rounded up, per purchase). Reloads the world.
AD2E.SP.Off: The Skills & Powers weapon rules are off (world setting): these proficiencies use no slots and give no benefit.
AD2E.SP.ChoiceHint: Weapon of choice: +1 to attack rolls with this weapon (Weapon Specialization and Mastery (POSP)).
AD2E.SP.ExpertiseHint: Weapon expertise: extra attacks as a weapon specialist, no attack or damage bonus.
AD2E.SP.MasteryHint: Weapon mastery (Table 54): needs specialization and the minimum level; melee +3 attack / +3 damage, missile +2 attack (+3 / +3 at point blank).
AD2E.SP.WeaponNote: Skills & Powers options (used only with the world setting).
AD2E.SP.ImprovedHint: One-handed weapon style: AC bonus +2 instead of +1; two weapon style: two weapons of equal size (2 more character points).
AD2E.SP.Covered: proficient through a group (no slot for the weapon)

Invalid.specLevel: Below the minimum level for specialization (Table 53).
Invalid.specOne: Only one weapon can be specialized.
Invalid.masteryClass: This class cannot gain weapon mastery (Table 54).
Invalid.masteryLevel: Below the minimum level for mastery (Table 54).
Invalid.masteryNeedsSpec: Mastery needs a valid specialization in this weapon.
Invalid.groupClass: Group proficiencies are for warriors only.
Invalid.styleOne: Priests, rogues and wizards can specialize in one style only.
Invalid.shieldClass: This class cannot use a shield.
Invalid.unknown: No group, style, armour or shield type set.

Effect.shield: Target's AC +{ac} (+{missile} vs missiles) against {n} attack(s) per round (tick box in the attacker's dialog)

style.one-handed: AC +1 (+2 improved) with one one-handed weapon and nothing in the other hand
style.weapon-shield: AC +1 with a shield and a weapon, or +1 attack that round (attack dialog)
style.two-handed: Speed factor -3 for weapons wielded in two hands; +1 damage with a one-handed weapon used two-handed
style.two-weapon: Two-weapon penalties 0 / -2 (improved: weapons of equal size)
style.missile: Move half and make all missile attacks, or full and half the attacks (attack dialog); AC +1 vs missiles in a round it shoots (attackers' dialogs)
style.horse-archery: Shooting from the saddle: no penalty up to half the mount's speed, -2 faster (attack dialog when riding)
style.thrown: As the missile style, for thrown weapons and slings
style.special: Benefit set by the DM (not automated)

AD2E.SP.WeaponShieldAttack: Weapon and shield style: +{n} attack (no +1 AC this round)

OwnMoveOption.half: Up to half your movement (all attacks)

OwnMoveNote.half: moved up to half: all attacks (missile style)
OwnMoveNote.full: moved more than half: half the attacks (missile style)

AD2E.SP.TargetShooting: {name} shoots this round (missile style, AC +1 vs missiles)

AD2E.Shair.ReplacementsHint: Gens summoned after the first: each adds one round, turn or hour to every search (Requesting a Spell (AA)).
AD2E.Shair.Note: Sha'irs do not memorize spells. Spells listed here are the ones the sha'ir knows exist; Request sends the gen for one. The gen returns when world time reaches the end of its search, and a spell it brings must be cast within three turns.
AD2E.Shair.Searching: Gen searching for {spell}: {n} {unit} (about {min} min of world time left).
AD2E.Shair.Ready: {spell} brought: cast it within about {min} min of world time.
AD2E.Shair.ReturnNowHint: GM: end the gen's search now instead of waiting for world time.
AD2E.Shair.NoGen: Choose the gen's kind on the Spells tab first.
AD2E.Shair.Busy: The gen is still busy with {name}.
AD2E.Shair.RequestText: Chance of success {chance}% ({parts}); a roll of 90 or more always fails.
AD2E.Shair.PriestWarning: Priest spell: {chance}% chance that a god notices the gen; if so, retribution comes when the spell is cast.
AD2E.Shair.Departs: {name}'s gen leaves to find {spell}: it will be gone {n} {unit}.
AD2E.Shair.CheckFlavor: Gen's search for {spell} (needs {chance} or less, 90+ fails)
AD2E.Shair.ReturnsWith: The gen returns with {spell}. It must be cast within {n} turns.
AD2E.Shair.Expired: {spell} was not cast in time and is lost.
AD2E.Shair.Retribution: {name} casts {spell}, which a god noticed: divine retribution ({band}). See Requesting a Spell (AA), The Perils of Priest Spells.

Band.1-2: 1st-2nd level: attract evil eye, no saving throw
Band.3-4: 3rd-4th level: the next opponent +1 attack and damage this encounter
Band.5-6: 5th-6th level: a messenger monster arrives in 1d6 rounds
Band.7: 7th level: the caster is taken before the god

AD2E.Gen.WardText: Protected against {province}: attacks -2 to hit, saving throws +2, damage -2 per die (at least 1 per die)
AD2E.Gen.SummonText: {name} fasts and communes with the elemental planes for {time} hours, uninterrupted (no proficiency check needed). Summon the gen now?
AD2E.Gen.Summoned: {name} summons and binds a gen: {gen} ({hours} hours; loyalty {loyalty}).
AD2E.Gen.DismissText: Dismiss {gen}? The sha'ir loses no hit points, but the next gen's loyalty is 1 lower. The actor stays in the world for the GM to remove.
AD2E.Gen.Missing: The linked gen actor no longer exists.
AD2E.Gen.NearHint: The sha'ir has the gen's protection against its element only while the gen is within 10 feet.
AD2E.Gen.DeathHalved: {name}'s hit points drop by half ({from} to {to}).
AD2E.Gen.DeathSaved: Saving throw vs. death magic (needs {needs}): saved, 1 hit point left.
AD2E.Gen.DeathFailed: Saving throw vs. death magic (needs {needs}): failed, the sha'ir dies.
AD2E.Gen.Died: {gen} has died. Resolve it on {name}'s sheet (Spells tab: Gen died).
AD2E.Gen.Warded: {name} (gen protection): {from} damage becomes {to} (-2 per die of the gen's element, at least 1 per die).
AD2E.Gen.CharmText: Charmed: turns against its master only if a morale check fails
AD2E.Gen.RelinkText: {name} summons and binds {gen} again ({time} hours): the link is restored with the same gen, no replacement.
AD2E.Gen.Relinked: {name} binds {gen} again ({hours} hours): the link is restored.

Broken.dispel: The link between {name} and {gen} is broken (dispel magic): no protection or spells until the gen is summoned again.
Broken.masterDeath: {name} has died: {gen} is freed and returns to its elemental plane. If {name} is raised, the same gen can be summoned and bound again.

AD2E.Gen.LinkBroken: Link broken: summon the same gen to restore it.
AD2E.Gen.BreakHint: Dispel magic (or a similar spell) broke the link: the sha'ir is not harmed and can summon this same gen again.
AD2E.Gen.Raised: {gen} is brought back to life: loyalty {loyalty} (a permanent 1-point penalty in morale and loyalty).
AD2E.Gen.RaiseHint: A gen that has died and is brought back to life loses 1 point of morale and loyalty for good.
AD2E.Gen.AwayText: Why is the gen away from its master? It gives no protection while away.
AD2E.Gen.AwayHint: Forced beyond 100 yards or threatened more than 10 feet away (back in 1d6 turns), following its master to another plane (1d6 days; elemental plane 1d6 rounds), or an errand (until recalled).

Away.errand: spying, an errand or a message

AD2E.Gen.AwayErrand: {gen} is away on an errand until recalled.
AD2E.Gen.Sense: The sha'ir senses that it is alive.
AD2E.Gen.NotHere: The gen is away from its master and cannot be sent for a spell.

AD2E.Mounted.Smaller: Mounted on {name}: target smaller than the mount, not a rider ({n})
AD2E.Mounted.VsRider: On foot against a mounted rider, not the mount ({n})

Issue.noRiding: DMG: missile fire from a moving mount needs the riding proficiency
Issue.weapon: DMG: only short bows, composite short bows and light crossbows can be fired from a moving mount
Issue.specialistOnly: DMG: long bows from a moving mount only for specialists
Issue.once: DMG: a heavy crossbow can be fired once from a mount, not reloaded

AD2E.Mounted.TrainedHint: Riders of a mount not trained for combat have -2 to hit (Unusual Combat Situations (DMG)). By default only war mounts are trained.

AD2E.Push.Hint: Push the animal to double or triple its daily movement: saving throw vs. death (Movement (DMG)).
AD2E.Push.Title: Push {name}
AD2E.Push.Note: Saving throw vs. death: needs {target}. Double: -1 per previous day at double speed ({previous}), ponies, donkeys and mules +2 ({hardy}). Triple: -3.
AD2E.Push.FlavorDouble: {name} pushed to double movement (save vs. death, needs {target})
AD2E.Push.FlavorTriple: {name} pushed to triple movement (save vs. death, needs {target})
AD2E.Push.Lame: lame or spent: no more travel today; normal speed only until rested at least one day
AD2E.Push.Spent: spent: must be rested, not ridden, for {days} days

State.lame: Lame: normal speed only, rest needed ({hours} h)

Blocked.lame: {name} is lame or spent and cannot be pushed until rested.
Blocked.spent: {name} is spent and must be rested, not ridden.

AD2E.Riders.SettingHint: A character riding an animal (Ride on the character sheet) and that animal's token move together on the canvas: moving either token moves the other along the same path. Only tokens that touch when the move starts.

AD2E.Identify.Hint: Unticked: players see only the unidentified name; the source link, notes, values, charges and magical bonus are hidden from them (the bonus still applies). GM only.
AD2E.Identify.Name: Unidentified name
AD2E.Identify.NameHint: Shown to everyone while unidentified (blank: a generic name, e.g. "Unidentified item (Rings)" or the weapon's base name).

AD2E.Treasure.ButtonHint: Roll this creature's treasure types (DMG Table 84) and post the result to the GM.
AD2E.Treasure.Title: Roll treasure
AD2E.Treasure.LettersHint: Letters A-Z from DMG Table 84; "Q x5" rolls Q five times.
AD2E.Treasure.AddSelected: Add to the selected token's actor
AD2E.Treasure.SelectToken: Select the token of the actor that receives the treasure.
AD2E.Treasure.Added: Added to {name}; magical items are unidentified.

AD2E.Firearm.NoPowder: {name}: no gunpowder or smokepowder (one per shot).
AD2E.Firearm.NoMatch: {name}: a matchlock or hand match weapon needs a slow match.
AD2E.Firearm.Wet: Wet conditions (misfire on {wet} or less instead of {dry})
AD2E.Firearm.setCharge: Set to receive a charge (double damage)

AD2E.Trait.SectionHint: Player's Option: Skills & Powers Tables 46 and 47. Without character points, traits are balanced by disadvantages: the traits' cost may not exceed the disadvantages' points. Drag them from the Traits & Disadvantages (POSP) compendium.
AD2E.Trait.DropHint: Drag traits and disadvantages here from the Traits & Disadvantages (POSP) compendium.
AD2E.Trait.Effects: Applied in rolls (tick boxes when conditional):
AD2E.Trait.SheetHint: Traits are balanced by disadvantages on the character sheet (no character points, owner's ruling). Ambidexterity (two-weapon penalties 0 / -2) and Fast Healer (2 hit points a day of normal rest) are applied by the system; other effects are listed above or left to the GM (see the description).
